company.name: Innhance
company.description: Innhance is the intelligent WhatsApp AI agent that seamlessly converts guest inquiries into confirmed reservations for your boutique hotel.

hero.headline: Turn WhatsApp Chats into Hotel Bookings
hero.subheadline: Innhance is the intelligent WhatsApp AI agent that seamlessly converts guest inquiries into confirmed reservations for your boutique hotel.

storytelling.heading: The Friction
storytelling.description: Arnav sitting late night, laptop open, Multiple hotel tabs, WhatsApp chats, booking pages
storytelling.dialogue: Why is booking a hotel still this complicated?

storytelling.heading: The Frustration
storytelling.description: The reality was clear: hotels weren't losing guests due to low demand, they were losing them to slow response times.
storytelling.dialogue: Hotels are losing customers… not because of demand but because they reply too late

storytelling.heading: The Gap
storytelling.description: In the modern digital age, a delayed reply often means the guest has already moved on to a competitor.

storytelling.heading: The Realization
storytelling.description: The solution was right in front of us. Everyone uses WhatsApp. Why not make it the ultimate booking engine?
storytelling.dialogue: What if bookings could happen instantly… on WhatsApp itself?

storytelling.heading: The Idea
storytelling.description: We envisioned an intelligent system that could answer queries, check availability, and secure bookings autonomously.
storytelling.dialogue: An AI that replies instantly, answers queries, and converts chats into bookings

storytelling.heading: Assembling the Team
storytelling.description: We brought together experts in hospitality growth and technical architecture to build something revolutionary.
storytelling.dialogue: This is not just a tool, this can change how hotels sell.

storytelling.heading: The Build Begins
storytelling.description: Late nights turned into early mornings as we mapped out intricate WhatsApp conversation flows.
storytelling.dialogue: Now we needed someone who could build this fast

storytelling.heading: Development
storytelling.description: Complex API integrations and conversational models were woven together to create a seamless experience.
storytelling.dialogue: Then came Harsh who turned the idea into an actual product

storytelling.heading: The First Version
storytelling.description: Our initial prototype was simple, but seeing it autonomously handle a guest inquiry was a breakthrough.
storytelling.dialogue:
Guest: Price? 
 Bot: Here are your room options

storytelling.heading: Early Success
storytelling.description: Our partner hotels immediately noticed the difference. Response times dropped to seconds, and conversions skyrocketed.
storytelling.dialogue:
Hotels started replying instantly 
  Guests started booking directly

storytelling.heading: The Shift
storytelling.description: Properties began capturing significantly more direct revenue, drastically reducing their reliance on expensive OTAs.
storytelling.dialogue:
Less dependency on OTAs 
 More direct bookings

storytelling.heading: The Launch
storytelling.description: After rigorous testing, we officially launched our platform to empower hospitality businesses worldwide.
storytelling.dialogue:
Innhance was born 
 to help hotels convert conversations into revenue

faqs.question: How quickly does Innhance respond to guests?
faqs.answer: Innhance responds to guests instantly, usually within seconds. This ensures that no inquiry goes unanswered and helps improve booking conversion rates.

faqs.question: Can I integrate Innhance with my existing property management system (PMS)?
faqs.answer: Yes! Innhance integrates seamlessly with most major PMS and booking engines, allowing real-time availability sync and instant booking confirmation.

faqs.question: Does Innhance support multiple languages?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Innhance supports over 7 languages, including Hindi, English,Spanish,Arabic etc. ensuring you can serve guests from anywhere in their preferred language.

faqs.question: How are payments handled on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: We provide secure UPI and Card payment links directly within the WhatsApp chat. Guests can pay quickly and safely, and the payment is routed directly to your hotel's account.

faqs.question: What happens if the AI cannot answer a question?
faqs.answer: If Innhance encounters a complex query it cannot handle, it seamlessly transfers the conversation to a human staff member, notifying them so they can take over without the guest noticing.
